verdict.rationale: Cake's only documented programmatic surface for agents is an MCP connection that is explicitly "All read-only", so an agent cannot draft option grants or other securities through it. No OpenAPI or write API was found. Board sign-off flows exist, but only as a UI feature, which is adjacent and does not let an agent queue drafts for approval.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
